verdicts.argument: The specification does not contain any reference that defines shaft depth, cover type or waterproofing, so the contractor’s concern cannot be substantiated.
No adjacent line item provides the missing installation depth, bedding or backfill details, therefore the objection lacks textual support.
The documents do not contain a pressure rating or pipe class for the PE‑HD pipe, and no neighboring item clarifies this, so the claim cannot be backed up.
There is no reference in the surrounding specifications that defines the formwork type or surface finish, thus the issue remains unsupported.
Both DIN EN 206 and DIN 1045 are explicitly listed in the description, so the contractor’s concern about an outdated reference is already addressed in the text.
The tender documents contain no separate position for site setup, and no other clause clarifies this, so the objection cannot be confirmed.
